an10.108:1.1: tikicchakā bhikkhave virecanaṃ denti pittasamuṭṭhānānampi ābādhānaṃ paṭighātāya, semhasamuṭṭhānānampi ābādhānaṃ paṭighātāya, vātasamuṭṭhānānampi ābādhānaṃ paṭighātāya,
an10.108:1.2: atthetaṃ bhikkhave virecanaṃ netaṃ natthi ti vadāmi.
an10.108:1.3: tañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave virecanaṃ sampajjatipi, vipajjatipi.
an10.108:2.1: ahañca kho bhikkhave ariyaṃ virecanaṃ desissāmi, yaṃ virecanaṃ sampajjatiyeva no vipajjati, yaṃ virecanaṃ āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti, jarādhammā sattā jarāya parimuccanti, maraṇadhammā sattā maraṇena parimuccanti, sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā sattā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi parimuccanti.
an10.108:2.3: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhu bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an10.108:3.1: katamañca taṃ bhikkhave ariyaṃ virecanaṃ, yaṃ virecanaṃ āgamma jāti dhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti, jarādhammā sattā jarāya parimuccanti, maraṇadhammā sattā maraṇena parimuccanti, sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā sattā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi parimuccanti:
an10.108:4.2: ye ca micchādiṭṭhipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, te cassa virittā honti.
an10.108:4.3: sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanā pāripūriṃ gacchanti.
an10.108:6.2: ye ca micchāvimuttipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti. te cassa virittā honti.
an10.108:6.3: sammāvimutti paccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanā pāripūriṃ gacchanti.
an10.108:6.4: idaṃ kho taṃ bhikkhave ariyaṃ virecanaṃ, yaṃ virecanaṃ sampajjatiyeva no vipajjati. yaṃ virecanaṃ āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti. jarādhammā sattā jarāya parimuccanti. maraṇadhammā sattā maraṇena parimuccanti, sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā sattā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi parimuccantī
